endpoint_interpretation: The three scaffolds use two precipitant-midpoint assays and one ultracentrifugation-supernatant assay. Their numerical outcomes must be analysed by scaffold/assay and are not a single pooled logS target.
representation_interpretation: Most variants contain non-natural residues whose chemical identity is not represented by canonical ProtT5 or ESM-2 residue tokens.
limitations: Only three related peptide scaffolds were experimentally studied.
The 40,000 and 50,000 scale values in the paper are computational predictions, not experimental solubility records.
The audit reports aggregate counts and does not certify chemical-entity canonicalization.
